headline: Experts warn AI leaders are open to honey-trap schemes
pages: Security experts say many people in the AI industry are exposed to honey-trap schemes, as fallout continues from allegations involving Nvidia chief Jensen Huang. He is accused of having an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive of a Singapore cloud firm who is accused of being a Chinese spy and smuggling billions of dollars of restricted Nvidia chips into China. Former CIA officer Aaron Brown, now a software founder, told TechCrunch that nobody briefs founders on counterintelligence, even though many valuable secrets now sit inside companies building chips, models and infrastructure.

The Wall Street Journal reported that OpenAI has warned employees about outsiders trying to get close to them for secrets. Brown said anyone with access, from board members to executive assistants, can be targeted, and that friendship is the oldest honey-trap approach. Attackers often pose as investors, customers, recruiters or consultants. Source: TechCrunch.
